description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 16.08.2021 to 22.08.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement under customs laws. It is issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and rescinds a previous notification, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
